detaileddescription.para: Commands to an unconfigured bootloader (#364). CONNECT names the board's UID hash (AnnounceField::UID16); only that board binds the session and answers on UNCONFIGURED_RSP_ID. One unconfigured board on the bus at a time.

Blocks a host may send ahead of the last ack (#366). The bootloader buffers their frames while it writes flash; a lost block is resent from BLOCK_ACK's next (go-back-N). BEGIN erases every page the image needs before it replies, so no erase stalls the stream.

detaileddescription.para: The app sets backup register DR1 to ENTRY_MAGIC and resets to enter the bootloader (#365). The bootloader clears it on read. The backup domain survives a reset, not a power cycle.
The last 16 bytes of the bootloader's 4 KB. A running app reads it to know a bootloader is present (and so whether it may honour an enter request) and which protocol it speaks (READY_n byte 3).

detaileddescription.para: A host writes this export address (any value) to ask the bridge's app to reset into its bootloader — the bridge's counterpart of a node's CONNECT on BOOT_CMD_n. Honoured only with a bootloader installed.

Crash-loop counter (#364): the bootloader adds one before every jump to the app; the app sets it back to 0 once it is healthy (STM32Board::markBootHealthy()). At ATTEMPT_LIMIT the bootloader stays (BootState::APP_UNSTABLE). Cleared by a committed image and by GO; lost on a power cycle.
